query:
SELECT COUNT(*) as duplicate_count
FROM (
  SELECT 
    p1.id as id1,
    p2.id as id2
  FROM price_history p1
  JOIN price_history p2 ON (
    p1.id < p2.id
    AND p1.card_id = p2.card_id
    AND p1.source = p2.source
    AND p1.source = 'snkrdunk'
    AND p1.jpy_price = p2.jpy_price
    AND COALESCE(p1.grade, '') = COALESCE(p2.grade, '')
    AND p1.source_position = p2.source_position
    AND ABS(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, p1.sold_at, p2.sold_at)) <= 72
  )
) as dupes;
